Vejen is a Danish municipality mentioned in the 2022–2023 Annual Report from the Danish Atrial Fibrillation Database, published by the Regions' Clinical Quality Development Programme (RKKP) [^src1]. The report assesses the clinical quality of atrial fibrillation treatment across Denmark, utilizing data from the Danish National Patient Register (LPR) and the Danish Stroke Registry (DanStroke) to evaluate metrics such as the prevention of ischemic stroke through anticoagulation therapy (Indicator 5) [^src1]. Vejen is specifically included in the municipality-level breakdown for Indicator 5, with its data on stroke events among atrial fibrillation patients presented in a statistical table on page 95 of the report [^src1]. 

Because the provided documentation is limited to this single tabular entry, no additional claims, relationships, or timeline events regarding Vejen are available in the corpus.
